svg.title: The six-step first-run tour
svg.desc: The tour runs against the real daemon. 1, Welcome: What a Genome and a World are, and the one promise: every claim carries a receipt. 2, Your first World: Registers the bundled example World and two agents: a parent and a changed child. 3, Unfreeze and run: Releases the brake Hephaestus starts with, then runs the parent once in a sandbox. 4, Measure in the Arena: Parent versus child on the same tasks: who won, by how much, and how sure we are. 5, Prove it: Rebuilds everything from the record and checks it matches the live state exactly. 6, Done: Where every screen lives, and how to replay this tour with heph --tour.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
